import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and a grid of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# Plot 1: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', multiple='stack', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='pastel')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Count')

# Plot 2: Boxplot of Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Quality of Sleep', ax=axes[0, 1], palette='Set2')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Quality of Sleep by BMI Category')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')

# Plot 3: Scatter plot of Physical Activity Level vs Daily Steps
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Daily Steps', hue='Sleep Disorder', ax=axes[1, 0], palette='Set1')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Physical Activity Level vs Daily Steps')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Daily Steps')

# Plot 4: Barplot of Average Stress Level by Occupation
avg_stress_by_occupation = df.groupby('Occupation')['Stress Level'].mean().reset_index()
sns.barplot(data=avg_stress_by_occupation, x='Stress Level', y='Occupation', ax=axes[1, 1], palette='Blues_d')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Stress Level by Occupation')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Average Stress Level')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Occupation')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# Create a figure and a grid of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))

# Plot 1: Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender
sns.histplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', hue='Gender', multiple='stack', ax=axes[0, 0], palette='pastel')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by Gender')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Count')

# Plot 2: Boxplot of Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
sns.boxplot(data=df, x='BMI Category', y='Quality of Sleep', ax=axes[0, 1], palette='Set2')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Quality of Sleep by BMI Category')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')

# Plot 3: Scatter plot of Physical Activity Level vs Daily Steps
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Daily Steps', hue='Sleep Disorder', ax=axes[1, 0], palette='Set1')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Physical Activity Level vs Daily Steps')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Daily Steps')

# Plot 4: Barplot of Average Stress Level by Occupation
avg_stress_by_occupation = df.groupby('Occupation')['Stress Level'].mean().reset_index()
sns.barplot(data=avg_stress_by_occupation, x='Stress Level', y='Occupation', ax=axes[1, 1], palette='Blues_d')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Stress Level by Occupation')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Average Stress Level')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Occupation')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
